Summary
Platform engineer with ten years of experience building batch pipelines,

and clear runbooks. Has led teams of three to six engineers.
Comfortable owning a system from design through on-call. Writes short
design notes before large changes and keeps them with the code.
Looking for a platform role on a small, steady team.
